## What's new

- **Wall layers 1–4 are always there.** The layer bar above the map, the Layers panel, the Active layer list and the Cell panel always offer all four wall layers, even when the map has fewer. You can toggle them, pick them and paint on them right away.
  - A wall layer the map doesn't have yet is shown dashed in the layer bar and lists as empty.
  - The map gets the layer the moment you put a tile on it, by painting, Add in the Cell panel and so on. Adding the layer is its own undo step ("Add wall layer 4"); a paint stroke stays one step.
  - Opening or saving a map never adds layers by itself: the file only changes when you use the layer.
